newsitem.title: UK: Granada appoints media group chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Granada appoints media group chief executive.

text.p: Britain's Granada Group Plc said on Friday it had appointed Steve Morrison, currently chief operating office of Granada Media Group, as chief executive of its media group with immediate effect.

His appointment follows the departure of Duncan Lewis from Granada. "Both Duncan and Granada Group management have recognised an incompatibility of approaches and have therefore agreed to part on an amicable basis," said the company.
Media is one of four divisions of Granada. The others are hotels, restaurants and rentals.
